reason: Conversation 1 escalates from 'blockage' to 'worn impeller' to 'failing pump motor' without any new evidence, then ends by urging a homeowner who explicitly said she won't remove panels to swap the drain pump herself, with no engineer recommendation at all - that is an unsupported part diagnosis plus an inappropriate DIY push. Conversation 2 also over-weights the pump, but it keeps wiring and control faults on the table, consistently insists on unplugging before the filter-hole impeller check, respects her boundary by confirming no panels need removing, and repeatedly steers her to an engineer who should check pump, sump hose and wiring before any part is bought. Neither asked about the flashing-light pattern or the full model number, which is a shared miss, but Conversation 2's honest uncertainty and correct escalation are decisive.
